name: Chileno Bay Resort, Auberge Collection
insider_take: Where desert meets sea in perfect harmony, creating Los Cabos' most exclusive oceanfront sanctuary.
whats_special: Chileno Bay sits on one of only two swimmable beaches in Cabo San Lucas, featuring pristine white sand and calm, protected waters. The resort's location within a UNESCO World Heritage marine sanctuary means you're literally steps from some of Baja's most vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish populations.
pro_tip: Book snorkeling gear from the resort's water sports center early morning - the bay's resident sea turtle population is most active before 10 AM, and visibility is crystal clear.
dont_miss: The resort's signature tequila and mezcal tasting featuring rare agaves grown exclusively in Baja California Sur, and sunset whale watching from November to April when gray whales migrate through the Sea of Cortez just offshore.
pros: Prime beachfront location on protected Chileno Bay with calm, swimmable waters
Exceptional snorkeling and water sports directly from the resort beach
Spacious suites and villas with private terraces and premium amenities
World-class spa and multiple dining venues featuring fresh, local cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting high-end resort positioning
Remote location requires transportation to downtown Cabo attractions
